focus: Releases v4.0.0.6 and v4.0.0.7 in the deep loop: mode-retirement remnants, the fan-out reducer-stamp guard, and the deep-review Case-line enforcement
answeredQuestions: Mode retirement (v4.0.0.7): which remnants of agent-improvement or model-benchmark survive in system-deep-loop runtime code, mode-registry.json, /deep:* commands or tests?

graphEvents.label: Dead scorer paths survive in fanout-merge test fixtures
Reducer stamp guard is a whole-file substring test

label: Live test fixtures in fanout-merge.vitest.ts still cite scorer paths under the retired deep-improvement packet (score-model-variant.cjs, grader/harness.cjs, run-benchmark.cjs); the directory no longer exists, so the paths are dead while the suite still passes on string fixtures, and unlike the deliberate RETIRED_CENSUS_SURFACE_IDS case they carry no note saying the sample is frozen.

The fan-out reducer-provenance guard classifies a dashboard with content.includes(stamp) over the whole file, not the frontmatter description line, so a hand-written dashboard that quotes 'description: Auto-generated reducer view over the research packet.' anywhere in its body is accepted as reducer-written and its unreduced registry merges.
verify: Add the stamp sentence to a hand-written lineage dashboard body, run the fan-out merge, confirm the lineage is absent from refused_reducer_provenance.

label: The deep-review Case-line requirement is prompt-level only: agents/deep-review.md:221 states a finding with no case is not reported at any severity, but no Case:/caseLine/hasCase test exists in deep-review/scripts or runtime/scripts, so a finding delta without a Case line is kept and counted.

The fan-out merge has three provenance outcomes but the attribution table renders two cells (refusedLineages ? REFUSED : verdict) and the merge status is ok in every case, so a lineage merged with unverified provenance reads like a verified one and a refused lineage is invisible to anyone reading only exit status.

deep-ai-council changelogs still describe deep-agent-improvement as a live sibling (v1.3.0.0 rejoins it, v1.2.0.0 places it in the sk-util family), against the note's 'no other skill documents or links to them'; changelog history should stay unedited but carries no signal that the sibling is gone.

The research reducer emits the dashboard stamp byte-for-byte ('description: Auto-generated reducer view over the research packet.' with the trailing period) and the shipped deep-research-dashboard.md asset does not carry it, so the substring guard yields the documented verdict in both directions for reducer-written and scaffolded-then-hand-edited dashboards.

Mode retirement is complete on every executing surface: mode-registry.json holds three modes keyed by workflowMode, and the retired spellings appear in no runtime lib/script, no command, no agent and no runtime mirror; survivors are test fixtures, the deliberate retired-census list, historical benchmark reports and changelog prose.
JEV_FEATURE_VERDICT_FALLBACK and JEV_FEATURE_HALLUCINATION_GRADER have no reader anywhere under .skilled outside changelogs, confirming the v4.0.0.7 upgrade note.
RETIRED_CENSUS_SURFACE_IDS is load-bearing history, not over-engineering: removing it would leave census rows unaccounted for, and no runtime file references those ids, so it should stay as is.
